courses.title: Full Stack Angular + .NET
courses.subtitle: Angular 17 + .NET 8 + C# 12 + ASP.NET Core Web API + SQL Server
courses.overview: Build a full stack job portal style application with Angular, TypeScript, .NET 8, C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, JWT authentication, SignalR, testing, and deployment. This program combines Angular frontend development, .NET backend/API development, and end-to-end API integration into one job-ready course.
outcomes: Build Angular applications with components, routing, forms, services, RxJS, and Angular Material
Develop ASP.NET Core Web APIs using C#, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, middleware, caching, and clean architecture patterns
Implement JWT authentication, authorization, file uploads, validation, and real-time SignalR features across the stack
Integrate Angular with .NET APIs using HttpClient, interceptors, typed models, error handling, search, filters, and pagination
Test, dockerize, deploy, and present a complete full stack application with CI/CD basics

modules.title: Angular: TypeScript fundamentals
labs: Lab: Build a TypeScript class library: Create Employee, Department, and Project classes with interfaces and generics

modules.title: Angular: Angular architecture and setup
topics: Angular CLI — ng new, ng serve
labs: Lab: Set up Angular app with routing and feature modules: Create routing module, shared module, and lazy-loaded feature modules

modules.title: Angular: Components and templates
labs: Lab: Reusable job-card component: Build a job-card component with @Input for job data and @Output for apply button click event

modules.title: Angular: Services and dependency injection
labs: API Lab: Connect to .NET Web API: Create JobService calling GET /api/jobs, POST /api/applications with error handling and loading state

modules.title: Angular: Routing and navigation
labs: Lab: Job portal navigation: Routes for home, job-list, job-detail/:id, apply, login, dashboard with AuthGuard protection

modules.title: Angular: Forms — Template and Reactive
labs: Lab: Job application form: Reactive form with name, email, phone, experience, resume upload and cover letter with full validation

modules.title: Angular: RxJS and state management
labs: Lab: Live job search with RxJS: Real-time job search using debounceTime + switchMap + HttpClient to call the .NET API

modules.title: Angular: Authentication and JWT
labs: API Lab: Full auth flow with .NET JWT: Connect Angular login to .NET /auth/login, store JWT, attach to all requests via interceptor

modules.title: Angular: Angular Material and UI
labs: Lab: Dashboard with Angular Material: Employer dashboard with MatTable for applicants, MatDialog for details, MatSnackBar for notifications

modules.title: Angular: Testing, build and deployment
labs: Lab: Production build and deploy: Build Angular app, deploy to Vercel, connect to .NET API on Railway

modules.title: .NET & C#: C# fundamentals
labs: Lab: Job portal domain models: Create Job, Company, User, Application C# classes with properties, constructors and LINQ queries

modules.title: .NET & C#: Async programming
labs: Lab: Async job service: Write async methods to fetch jobs, process applications and send emails concurrently

modules.title: .NET & C#: ASP.NET Core Web API
topics: HTTP verbs — GET, POST, PUT, DELETE
labs: API Lab: Jobs Web API: Build JobsController with GET /api/jobs (with filtering), GET /api/jobs/{id}, POST, PUT, DELETE

modules.title: .NET & C#: Entity Framework Core
labs: Lab: Job portal database with EF Core: Create DbContext with Jobs, Companies, Users, Applications — run migrations on SQL Server

modules.title: .NET & C#: JWT authentication and authorization
labs: API Lab: Auth endpoints: Build /api/auth/register, /api/auth/login returning JWT. Protect endpoints with [Authorize(Roles = "Employer")]

modules.title: .NET & C#: Repository and service pattern
labs: Lab: Refactor to clean architecture: Move to Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API layers with IJobRepository and JobService

modules.title: .NET & C#: Middleware, filters and logging
labs: Lab: Request logging middleware: Log every API request with method, path, duration and response code using Serilog

modules.title: .NET & C#: Caching and performance
labs: Lab: Cache job listings: Cache GET /api/jobs with 5-minute expiry, invalidate on POST/PUT/DELETE

modules.title: .NET & C#: File handling and email
labs: Lab: Resume upload and email notification: Accept resume via IFormFile, save it, send confirmation email to applicant via SendGrid

modules.title: .NET & C#: SignalR — real-time communication
labs: Lab: Real-time application status: Employer updates status → SignalR notifies candidate browser instantly

modules.title: .NET & C#: Unit testing and integration testing
labs: Lab: Test job portal API: Unit test JobService with Moq, integration test JobsController with WebApplicationFactory

modules.title: .NET & C#: Deployment — Docker and cloud
labs: Lab: Deploy .NET API to Railway: Dockerize .NET API, push to GitHub, auto-deploy to Railway via GitHub Actions

modules.title: API Integration: REST API fundamentals
topics: HTTP methods — GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
labs: Lab: Test .NET API with Postman: Test all job portal endpoints — GET jobs, POST login, POST apply — inspect headers, status codes, payloads

modules.title: API Integration: Angular HttpClient + .NET API
topics: Loading and error states in UI
labs: Lab: Job portal Angular services: Create JobService, AuthService, ApplicationService mapping to .NET API endpoints with full error handling

modules.title: API Integration: JWT auth flow — end to end
labs: Lab: Complete auth integration: Angular login → .NET JWT → interceptor attaches token → protected endpoints → role-based UI

modules.title: API Integration: File uploads and FormData
labs: Lab: Resume upload integration: Angular file upload with progress bar → .NET IFormFile → save → return URL → store in database

modules.title: API Integration: Search, filter and pagination
labs: Lab: Job search and filter: Angular search + filters → .NET LINQ query with pagination → display results with page navigation

modules.title: API Integration: SignalR — real-time features
labs: Lab: Application status notifications: Employer updates status → SignalR notifies candidate in real-time without page refresh

modules.title: API Integration: Error handling and validation
labs: Lab: Full validation across stack: FluentValidation in .NET → error response → Angular displays field errors with toast notifications

modules.title: API Integration: Full stack deployment
labs: Lab: Deploy full stack app: Angular on Vercel + .NET on Railway + Neon DB — push to GitHub triggers auto-deployment
